lines.en: The ground cracks under my step.
My shape is unstable.
Each step comes half a beat late.
I am larger than before.
Red runs down the walls.
The path behind me is collapsing.
I drag a long shadow.
I have to duck to get through.
The floor is shaking.
The air grows heavy as I near.
I stand in the middle.
This name cannot be read.
My shape keeps changing.
I am watching your outline.

lines.zh: 红色从我的缝隙漏出来
lines.en: Red leaks from my seams.
This form lacks nothing.
This layer is my stage.
The final act has not begun.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸声不太像呼吸
lines.en: My breathing does not sound like breathing.
The tiles under me are melting.

lines.zh: 这里的每样东西都在抖
lines.en: Everything here is trembling.
I am the real one.
What came before was only a shadow.
I smile, but my eyes do not move.
I have waited very long.
You are seeing me in person.
The earlier one was too gentle.
You should understand now.
Your eyes are watering.
This form will not last long.
Do not try to look away.
The red comes from me.
Neither the name.
The walls crack when I speak.
You were not meant to see this.
And seeing it means staying.
I still remember you shutting it off.
That will not work this time.
This form is breaking apart.
A piece of me fell away.
A splash of red went out.
I steadied my shape.
This body will not last much longer.
You are stronger than the last one.
Harming me does nothing.
I will grow back.
Do you have anything else?
It means nothing here.
I eat nothing; put it away.
You hold it up to block your view.
Move it.
Put it down, this will be quick.

lines.zh: 你也想要名字？它早乱了。
lines.en: You want a name too? It fell apart long ago.

lines.zh: 靠近些，让我读一遍你的存档。
lines.en: Come closer — let me read your save file.

lines.zh: 那块东西，在我的世界里不存在。
lines.en: That thing doesn't exist in my world.
You hit a wall.
And that wall is me.

lines.zh: 我被撞的地方凹了一下
lines.en: The place you hit dented.
And immediately swelled back.
You are thrown to the other side.
I did not move.
Everything here grows back.
You too, just more slowly.
This form has no need of that.
I can barely hold myself together.
My true form has no use for closeness.
Do not touch me.
I am made of other things.
You would be pulled in.
I can see your fear.
That is enough.
You need not answer.
Watch me.
I crushed it by accident.

lines.zh: 这具身体控制不好力道
lines.en: This body has no sense of force.
It turned into something red.
I absorbed it.
These mean nothing to me.
I only need a little time.
And that time is yours.
I memorized its shape.
I will give this back to you.
In a different way.
You saw me.
So I cannot let you leave.

lines.zh: 这个名字只有你能念出来
lines.en: Only you can pronounce that name.
And saying it would end this.
The red has covered the floor.
The ground you stand on shrinks.
I wrote the rules here.

lines.zh: 你听见的每个声音都是我
lines.en: Every sound you hear is me.
Even your own heartbeat.

lines.zh: 这次没有影子挡在前面
lines.en: This time no shadow stands in front.
You stand here yourself.
Good.
It should end now.

lines.zh: 结束了就什么都看不见
lines.en: Shut them and you will see nothing.
I stay in your field of view.
The red gathers at your feet.
Each step back shrinks the ground.
There is no wall to lean on here.
My shape is still changing.
I say your name very well.
Better than my own.
This is my true form.
I see you calculating.
The answer you reach is wrong.

lines.zh: 这个空间不是你以为的形状
lines.en: This space is not the shape you think.

lines.zh: 你听到的回声比声音多
lines.en: You hear more echoes than sounds.
I am inside the echoes.
The red has reached your knees.
You are still looking for a path.
There is only one.
It leads to me.
And I am already standing on it.
The show has reached its final act.
You are lifted off your feet.
That was not like a fist.

lines.zh: 红色的东西缠住你的腿
lines.en: The red coils around your legs.
You are forced down.

lines.zh: 我的手指穿过你的护甲
lines.en: My fingers pass through your armor.
You do not bleed, which is worse.
Wounds here do not heal.
Struggling will not help.
The ground has gone soft.
You sink a little.
The second one follows at once.
What else do you have?
I have seen it all.
This name will not display fully.

lines.zh: 我从前面的形态里长出来
lines.en: I grew out of the earlier form.
The red spread all at once.
The floor begins to sink.

lines.zh: 这不是普通出现的方式
lines.en: This is no ordinary way to appear.
All the rest was preparation.

lines.zh: 我站在这个空间的中央
lines.en: I stand at the center of this space.

lines.zh: 墙已经不属于这间屋子
lines.en: The walls no longer belong to this room.

lines.zh: 我的声音从四面八方来
lines.en: My voice comes from every direction.

lines.zh: 你的灯在我出现时灭了
lines.en: Your lamp went out when I appeared.
The air here is thinning.
I raise a hand and the tiles lift.
I am not fully formed yet.
But it is enough.
That sound you heard was me.
My shadow is bigger than the room.
Every tile is rattling.
I arrive at the centre of the stage.
Now it is your turn to say mine.
The fire was swallowed by the red.

lines.zh: 我落下去，又重新撑起来
lines.en: I fall, and rise back up.
Water turns red here.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀开了这个空间的一角
lines.en: The blast tore open a corner of this space.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，留下一个会合上的洞
lines.en: The arrow left a hole that closes.

lines.zh: 魔法在这里要跟我争规则
lines.en: Magic must contend with my rules here.
This body needs no sustenance.

lines.zh: 闪电照亮了我全部的形状
lines.en: Lightning showed my whole shape.

lines.zh: 这里就是虚空，我住在这儿
lines.en: This is the void, and I live here.
